# Nijushi Corp.

> Nijushi Corp. empowers your digital future with intelligent solutions designed for those who value control and autonomy. The company builds and operates digital products and platforms, primarily serving the Indonesian market.

Nijushi Corp.'s main website is available in Indonesian (/id) and English (/en). Visitors are automatically directed to the appropriate language version based on their location.

## Company

- [Home](https://nijushicorp.biz.id/): Company overview and featured products
- [About](https://nijushicorp.biz.id/about): Information about Nijushi Corp.
- [Products](https://nijushicorp.biz.id/product): Full list of products and services
- [Contact / Social](https://nijushicorp.biz.id/social): Contact and social media channels
- [Status Monitoring](https://status.nijushicorp.biz.id): Live uptime status of Nijushi Corp. services

## Products

- [RukoGamer](https://rukogamer.com): Top-up platform for the Indonesian region, offering game/digital credits with low prices and fast processing
- [sometipfor.me](https://sometipfor.me): Donation and tipping platform for creators, with low fees and no limits
